meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行审计代码库，发现漏洞并验证可利用性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对代码库进行深度安全审查并验证漏洞可利用性
copy.tagline_en: Audit codebases in parallel, find vulnerabilities and verify exploitability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need deep security review of codebases with exploitability validation

howto.what: 在团队模式下，Claude会组建一个5人安全研究团队（3名漏洞猎人、2名PoC工程师），并行审计代码库，找出候选漏洞并用最小PoC验证其是否真实可利用，再按可利用性评估严重性，最后产出安全报告。
howto.when: 当你说出“security research”等触发词，或要求做安全审计、发布前安全检查时触发。需要先开启团队模式。

say.text: 帮我对当前仓库做一次安全审计。
检查这次代码变更有没有可利用的漏洞。
用 /security-research 跑一遍发布前检查。
say.note: 走完整流程并输出报告。

howto.what_en: In team mode, Claude assembles a 5-member security research team (3 vulnerability hunters, 2 PoC engineers) to audit the codebase in parallel, find candidate vulnerabilities, verify them with minimal PoCs, rate severity by real exploitability, and produce a security report.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say keywords such as 'security research' or ask for a security audit or pre-release check. Requires team mode enabled.

say_en.text: Run a security audit on this repo.
say_en.note: Claude forms a team and scans in parallel.

say_en.text: Check these code changes for exploitable bugs.
say_en.note: Focuses on the diff and changed files.
Runs the full workflow and outputs a report.
